RimCourt.Court.PetitionDef.label: what the dead left behind
RimCourt.Court.PetitionDef.description: Two kin of a dead colonist each claim what the dead left, and neither will yield to the other.
RimCourt.Court.PetitionDef.caseText:
{DEAD} is dead, and {DEAD} left things behind: a room, a coat, a place at the table that somebody has to take. {PETITIONER_labelShort} and {OTHER_labelShort} were each something to the dead, and each is certain the dead meant it all for them.
Nothing was written down. Nothing here ever is. That is what the seat is for.
How does the lord rule?

li.label: Declare the dead left nothing worth quarrelling over
